'''Raijin Shrine''' (雷神社, Ikazuchi-jinja, Raijin-jinja, Kaminari-jinja) refers to Shinto shrines located throughout Japan.

== Hokkaidō and Tōhoku Region ==
* [[Raijin Shrine (Daisen)]] (Ikazuchi-jinja) - Located in [[Daisen, Akita|Daisen]], [[Akita Prefecture|Akita Prefecture]].
* [[Raijin Shrine (Kaminoyama)]] (Raijin-jinja) - Located in [[Kaminoyama|Kaminoyama]], [[Yamagata Prefecture|Yamagata Prefecture]].
* [[Raijin Shrine (Kaneyama, Yamagata)]] (Raijin-jinja) - Located in [[Kaneyama, Yamagata|Kaneyama, Mogami District]], Mogami District, Yamagata Prefecture.
* [[Raijin Shrine (Kawanishi, Yamagata)]] (Raijin-jinja) - Located in [[Kawanishi, Yamagata|Kawanishi, Higashiokitama District]], Higashiokitama District, Yamagata Prefecture.
* [[Raijin Shrine (Shirataka)]] (Raijin-jinja) - Located in [[Shirataka|Shirataka, Nishiokitama District]], Nishiokitama District, Yamagata Prefecture.
* [[Raijin Shrine (Fukushima)]] - Located in [[Fukushima (city)|Fukushima]], [[Fukushima Prefecture|Fukushima Prefecture]], at Ōtamachi 7.
* [[Raijin Shrine (Fukushima)]] (Raijin-jinja) - Another location in Fukushima City, at Okabemachi Uchi.
* [[Raijin Shrine (Kōriyama)]] (Kaminari-jinja) - Located in [[Kōriyama|Kōriyama]], Fukushima Prefecture, at Narukami 3-chōme.
* [[Asaka Raijin Shrine]] (Asaka Kaminari-jinja) - Located in Kōriyama, at Hosonuma-chō.

== Kantō Region ==
* [[Raijin Shrine (Chikusei)]] (Raijin-jinja) - Located in [[Chikusei|Chikusei]], [[Ibaraki Prefecture|Ibaraki Prefecture]].
* [[Mikurayama Kofun]] (Ikazuchi-jinja/Raijin-jinja) - Located in [[Utsunomiya|Utsunomiya]], [[Tochigi Prefecture|Tochigi Prefecture]].
* [[Ikazuchi Shrine]] (Ikazuchi-jinja) - Located in [[Nagareyama|Nagareyama]], [[Chiba Prefecture|Chiba Prefecture]].
* [[Raijin Shrine (Chiba City)]] (Ikazuchi-jinja) - Located in [[Chiba (city)|Chiba]].
* [[Raijin Shrine (Ichihara)]] (Ikazuchi-jinja) - Located in [[Ichihara, Chiba|Ichihara]], Chiba Prefecture.
* [[Raijin Shrine (Katori)]] (Raijin-jinja) - Located in [[Katori, Chiba|Katori]], Chiba Prefecture.
* [[Raijin Shrine (Asahi City)]] (Raijin-jinja) - Located in [[Asahi, Chiba|Asahi]], Chiba Prefecture.
* [[Raijin Shrine (Narita)]] (Raijin-jinja) - Located in [[Narita, Chiba|Narita]], Chiba Prefecture, at Yamaguchi 1205. Annual festival held on July 24.
* [[Raijin Shrine (Adachi)]] (Ikazuchi-jinja) - Located in [[Adachi, Tokyo|Adachi]], [[Tokyo|Tokyo Metropolis]], in Nishiarai.
* [[Ikazuchi Shrine(Yokosuka)]] (Ikazuchi-jinja) - Located in [[Yokosuka|Yokosuka]], [[Kanagawa Prefecture|Kanagawa Prefecture]].

== Hokuriku, Kōshin, Tōkai Region and Beyond ==
* [[Raijin Shrine (Toyooka)]] (Ikazuchi-jinja) - Located in [[Toyooka, Hyōgo|Toyooka, Hyōgo]], [[Hyōgo Prefecture|Hyōgo Prefecture]]. A [[Myōjin Taisha]].
* [[Ikazuchi Shrine]] (Ikazuchi-jinja) - Located in [[Itoshima|Itoshima]], [[Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka Prefecture]].
